waiting.jpg.description: 谢尔顿在决赛中侧脸等待的特写。第四屏讲「接发的人被打断的是那个小跳」，画面里就是那个在等的人。
waiting.jpg.caption_en: Ben Shelton looks on during a Men's Singles championship match on Day Fifteen of the 2026 US Open at USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center on Sunday, September 13, 2026 in Flushing, NY.
waiting.jpg.author: Darren Carroll/USTA

crowd.jpg.description: 谢尔顿赢下第三盘，阿瑟·阿什球场全体起立。第五屏讲「拍球越久，全场安静越久」——这张正是被按住的那份声音。画面右下角烧着 IBM 的 139 MPH 发球测速，和这一条的主题是同一件事。
crowd.jpg.caption_en: The crowd reacts to Ben Shelton winning a set during a Men's Singles championship match on Day Fifteen of the 2026 US Open at USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center on Sunday, September 13, 2026 in Flushing, NY.
crowd.jpg.author: Garrett Ellwood/USTA

net-embrace.jpg.description: 决赛打完，两个人在网前拥抱。第二屏讲谢尔顿赛后提出的那条规则建议——用赛后握手这一刻，是因为这是一条关于规则的意见，不是两个人的私怨。原图 5593x3840，入库缩到 2400 宽。
net-embrace.jpg.caption_en: Germany's Alexander Zverev and Ben Shelton of the U.S. embrace at the net after their men's singles final.
net-embrace.jpg.author: Geoff Burke, IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters

from-the-stands.jpg.description: 从看台越过观众望向球场，谢尔顿正在抛球发球。第七屏讲「钟装上之后比赛变快了吗」——画面里就是这件事的两头：一个正在发球的人，和一圈在等的人。
from-the-stands.jpg.caption_en: A general view from the stands during a Men's Singles championship match between Alexander Zverev and Ben Shelton on Day Fifteen of the 2026 US Open at USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center on Sunday, September 13, 2026 in Flushing, NY.
